## Notes

Greenheart Games, 2012-12-10; Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Switch 2020. Garage start in the 1980s, engines, console licenses, offices, staff, R&D and Hardware labs; JavaScript gdt-modAPI mods; inspired by Game Dev Story; piracy stunt with in-game bankruptcy.
